# 支持 QuantWeft / Support QuantWeft

反馈读者卡点、校对译文、修复示例，或分享[官方阅读入口](https://quantweft.yuxiao.win)，都能帮助更多人使用这套课程。

Report a reader problem through the [feedback form](https://github.com/YuxiaoMa66/quantweft/issues/new?template=feedback.yml), contribute a focused correction using the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md), or share the official reading link.

## 自愿支持 / Voluntary support

自愿支持可帮助维护双语内容、Notebook 体验和网站。课程可按许可免费学习与复用。

Voluntary support helps maintain the bilingual course, Notebook experience, and website. The course remains available under its stated licenses.
